messages:
alana_s: Heads up — I just reproduced an SSRF via the image thumbnail fetcher. It follows redirects and will fetch metadata endpoints. example: curl -v 'POST https://app.redwood.ai/thumbnail' -F 'url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/'

mike_g: ugh. which env? prod/staging?

alana_s: Prod and staging. Repro steps attached (short): POST to /thumbnail with url param pointing at 169.254.169.254, service follows 302 from a redirector and fetches metadata.

sophie_r: any auth tokens leaked in request/response headers?

alana_s: No immediate token in body, but our fetcher logs include upstream response headers. If someone can trick redirect to internal admin endpoints that echo cookies/headers, could be bad. Also it sends Host header from the redirect target — bad for SSRF with host-based auth.

eli_dev: Can we just block 169.254.0.0/16 and RFC1918 on the fetcher?

ops-oncall: Yes we should add egress deny rules for metadata and private ranges at the proxy level ASAP. I'll open a firewall change.

mike_g: Flagging as incident. @security-bot can you create INC and notify CS and SRE?

security-bot: Created INC-2026-041. Notifying SRE, Product Security, and Support.

ops-oncall: Temporary mitigations I can do now: 1) disable remote URL fetching feature flag for thumbnail service in prod 2) add egress deny for 169.254.169.254 and 10.0.0.0/8 and 192.168.0.0/16 3) rate-limit fetcher to 5r/m per IP

sophie_r: Do we have logs to see if anyone exploited this? query we should run?

alana_s: Run this in logs: request_path:/thumbnail AND request_params.url:*169.254* OR request_headers.referer:*internal-admin* — but better to search redirects: upstream_response.status:302 AND upstream_response.location:*169.254*

mike_g: I'll run a broader query across last 72h and share results.

eli_dev: For patch: validate hostnames before fetch — allowlist only external domains, disallow IPs and private ranges, and do not follow redirects by default. If redirect present, validate the target. Also drop forwarding of sensitive headers when doing server-side fetch.

ops-oncall: Deploying firewall rule now (eta 5m). Also toggling feature flag off (eta 2m).

security-bot: Firewall rule applied to thumbnail-service egress. Feature flag toggled off in prod.

alana_s: Confirmed post-mitigation: unable to hit 169.254 from the service (connection refused).

ops-oncall: Good. Next steps: 1) rollout patch to validate URLs and disable redirect follow 2) add unit/e2e tests for redirect handling 3) audit logs for any anomalous 302 chains 4) rotate any machine credentials that might have been exposed (ops will review)

mike_g: I ran the 72h query — found ~12 requests from 8 distinct IPs hitting 169.254 through redirect chains, all within last 24h. No obvious data exfil logs, but need to assume potential access to metadata.

sophie_r: Ok escalate to rotate any instance credentials that could be accessed via metadata service. Ops, list affected instances/services.

ops-oncall: Will enumerate affected instances by matching request origins to service nodes and start rotations for service tokens and IAM roles used by those nodes. ETA 3h for initial rotations.

eli_dev: I'll open a PR with hostname validation + explicit no-follow option and tests. link: https://git.redwood.ai/repo/thumbnail-service/pulls/318

alana_s: Also adding logging change to scrub upstream headers from logs by default. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/repo/logging/pulls/77

mike_g: Notifying legal and support teams with canned message draft. Support: please prepare customer comms if any accounts show suspicious activity.

security-bot: Notified legal@redwood and support@redwood.

ops-oncall: Incident doc started: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/INC-2026-041 — adding actions and timeline.

alana_s: Postmortem action items assigned: ops-oncall (egress rules & rotations), eli_dev (patch + tests), sophie_r (audit logs & search queries), mike_g (comms & ticketing), alana_s (repro steps & detection rules).

mike_g: Closing note — we should add an assertion to our CI to reject code that does permissive redirect following or forwards incoming Host header as-is.

ops-oncall: Will keep the feature flag off until patch is deployed and validated.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-041 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

alana_s: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the postmortem thread with attacker indicators and log snippets once we finish log review. :white_check_mark:
